messages.text: [[room:35|Smelter|5]] built.
Amara Tanaka is waiting at the office: noise complaint.
Quiet hours are in force.
Dust storm forecast in about 3 months: charge the batteries, and expect little from the solar arrays while it blows.
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: a word from the residents.
[[room:36|Machine shop|5]] built.
Sana Reyes says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (the home itself).
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
[[room:38|Staging bay|5]] built.
The pipe run in [[room:16|Water recycler|2]] broke down: it's down to 39%.
[[room:26|Stairwell|1]] extended.
Supply drop delayed a month by dust over the landing zone. Earth sends its apologies.
[[room:40|Warehouse|2]] built.
Supply drop landed: colonists 1, earth rations 211, water 79, oxygen 1113, metal 25, brick 10, machinery 3, electronics 3, soil 15.
Kian Reyes says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it (smell).
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.
[[room:41|Warehouse|2]] built.
A dust storm has blown in: the solar arrays are making much less, and everyone's finding grit in their tea.
Still the same meal. Amara Sato is telling everyone you forgot about the galley.
[[room:42|Rover depot|S]] built.

outcomes: The lava tube on floor 3 is open: free space to build in, no digging required.
A toast to the first child born on Mars.
A toast to five floors down.
The Hygiea Star came down on our pad: six belters, safe, and their salvage. Everyone turned out to see, and somebody brought snacks.
